source: The spell can be cast at
The surrounding area suddenly burst into flames!
target: 周围顿时熊熊燃烧起来！

source: The weapons can see invisible creatures.
target: 这些武器可以看到隐形生物。

source: The weapons cannot be harmed by physical damage.
target: 这些武器不会受到物理伤害。

source: There are no minor injuries to patch up.
There is a loud whistling sound.
There is a price for this however, since it causes intense hallucinogenic delusions, and it is also severely addictive.
target: 然而，这是有代价的，因为它会引起强烈的致幻妄想，而且还会严重上瘾。

source: There is a sharp droning in my head!
target: 我的脑袋里传来尖锐的嗡嗡声！

source: There is a vague change in the air.
target: 空气中出现了隐约的变化。

source: There is nothing more to shed.
target: 没有什么可以流掉的了。

source: This device is completely alien to me, I could never understand it through normal means.
target: 这个装置对我来说完全陌生，我无法通过正常方式理解它。

source: This elixir fully restores all hit points, heals all wounds, and cures blindness, deafness, poisoning, infections, disease, weakening, and life sapping. Also, for some duration after consuming the potion, +1 extra hit point is healed per turn, and there is 10% chance per turn to heal one wound.
target: 这种灵药可完全恢复生命值、治愈所有创伤，并治愈失明、失聪、中毒、感染、疾病、虚弱和生命流失。此外，服用后的一段时间内，每回合额外恢复 1 点生命值，而且每回合有 10% 几率治愈一处创伤。

source: This is the dreaded Necronomicon - the Book of the Dead! Its pages contain much dire knowledge on esoteric matters. While carried, all spells are cast at a higher skill level, and it is possible to reach a fourth level, "Transcendent".
target: 这就是可怕的《死灵之书》——死亡之书！它的页面包含许多关于深奥问题的可怕知识。携带时，所有法术都会以更高的技能等级施展，并且有可能达到第四级“超凡”。

source: This place feels more serene now.
target: 这个地方现在感觉更加宁静了。

source: This powerful charm brings the owner back to life upon bodily death. The talisman is destroyed in the process however, so one may only be brought back once.
target: 这种强大的魅力可以使主人在身体死亡后复活。然而，护身符在此过程中被破坏，因此只能被带回来一次。

source: This spell can be cast silently.
target: 这个咒语可以无声地施展。

source: This strange concoction causes a sudden flash of intuition.
target: 这种奇怪的混合物引起了直觉的突然闪现。

source: This weapon can be used for
This weapon has a long reach, press [f] to attack further away.
target: 该武器射程较远，按[f]可以攻击更远的地方。

source: This weapon has an accuracy penalty at close ranges.
target: 该武器在近距离时精度会受到影响。

source: Through ardous suffering, the caster tempers their body to resist physical force (cannot be harmed by normal attacks, however other forms of damage such as fire is still harmful).
target: 施法者通过艰苦的痛苦磨练自己的身体以抵抗物理力量（普通攻击不会受到伤害，但其他形式的伤害（例如火焰）仍然会造成伤害）。

source: Typically used for construction, but can be quite devastating when wielded as a weapon.
target: 通常用于建筑，但作为武器使用时可能具有相当大的破坏性。

source: Victims struck by its flesh-tearing bite may be paralyzed with pain (20% chance).
target: 被它撕裂血肉的咬击击中后，受害者可能会因疼痛而瘫痪（20% 几率）。

source: Walking with the collar requires extra turns, and stealth and evasion are reduced by 20%. However, wearing the collar hardens the Flagellant against physical suffering, armor is increased by 3 points.
target: 佩戴项圈行走需要额外回合，潜行和闪避各降低 20%。不过，项圈能让鞭笞者更能忍受肉体痛苦，护甲值增加 3 点。

source: weakening, poisoning, infection and disease are cured.
target: 虚弱、中毒、感染和疾病得到治愈。

source: weakening, poisoning, infection, disease and slowing are cured.
target: 虚弱、中毒、感染、疾病和减速被治愈。

source: weakening, poisoning, infection, disease and slowing are cured. The caster is also blessed for
target: 虚弱、中毒、感染、疾病和减速被治愈。施法者也受到祝福

source: When activated, this device alters the atmosphere in order to cover the user in a dense mist. The mist is also strangely soothing (-10% temporary shock).
target: 启动后，装置会改变周围气氛，以浓雾笼罩使用者。雾气还会带来奇异的舒缓效果（临时震慑 -10%）。

source: When activated, this device blasts one visible hostile creature with infernal power.
target: 激活后，该装置会用地狱之力爆炸一个可见的敌对生物。

source: When activated, this device breaks the user free from any bonds (entangled, stuck, nailed), and ends slowing.
target: 当激活时，该装置使用户摆脱任何束缚（纠缠、卡住、钉住），并结束减速。

source: When activated, this device causes temporary deafness in all creatures in a large area, except for the user.
target: 激活后，该装置会导致大范围内除使用者外的所有生物暂时失聪。

source: When activated, this device clouds the memories of all creatures in the area, causing them to forget the presence of the user.
target: 当激活时，该装置会掩盖该区域所有生物的记忆，导致它们忘记用户的存在。

source: When activated, this device constructs a temporary opaque barrier around the user, blocking all physical matter. The barrier can only be created in empty spaces (i.e. not in spaces occupied by creatures, walls, etc).
target: 激活后，该设备会在用户周围构建一个临时的不透明屏障，阻挡所有物理物质。屏障只能在空的空间中创建（即不能在被生物、墙壁等占据的空间中）。

source: When activated, this device generates a shock wave which violently pushes away any adjacent creatures and destroys structures.
target: 当激活时，该装置会产生冲击波，猛烈地推开任何相邻的生物并摧毁建筑物。

source: When activated, this device heals all wounds and physical maladies. The procedure is very painful and invasive however, and causes great shock to the user.
target: 启动后，该装置会治愈所有创伤和身体疾病。不过，治疗过程非常痛苦且具有侵入性，会给使用者造成强烈震慑。

source: When activated, this device materializes an entryway somewhere in an adjacent surface.
target: 当激活时，该装置会在相邻表面的某处实体化入口。

source: When activated, this device moves the user a short distance.
target: 激活后，该设备会将用户移动一小段距离。

source: When activated, this device opens all locks, lids and doors in the surrounding area (except heavy doors operated externally by a switch).
target: 激活后，该设备会打开周围区域的所有锁、盖子和门（通过开关从外部操作的重型门除外）。

source: When activated, this device selects a single nearby seen creature, and attempts to hypnotize it, putting them to sleep if susceptible. It is unknown how the target selection works.
target: 激活后，该设备会选择附近看到的一个生物，并尝试对其进行催眠，如果易受影响，则将其置于睡眠状态。目前尚不清楚目标选择是如何进行的。

source: When activated, this device teleports all visible enemies to different locations.
target: 激活后，该设备会将所有可见的敌人传送到不同的位置。

source: When blown, this instrument forces all magically summoned creatures within hearing range back to their original realm.
target: 当吹响时，这个乐器会迫使所有在听觉范围内的魔法召唤生物回到原来的领域。

source: When blown, this sinister artifact emits a weird resonance which corrupts the psyche of all those within hearing range (excluding the horn blower) - causing them to consider all other creatures with intense hatred and distrust.
target: 当吹响时，这件邪恶的神器会发出一种奇怪的共鸣，这种共鸣会腐蚀所有在听觉范围内的人的心灵（不包括吹号者）——导致他们对所有其他生物抱有强烈的仇恨和不信任。

source: When casting the spell, select a seen object to control within the maximum distance.
target: 施法时，选择一个可见的物体来控制在最大距离内。

source: When thrown at a living (non-undead) creature, this powder causes paralyzation.
target: 当向活体（非不死）生物投掷时，这种粉末会导致麻痹。

source: When wielded by creatures lacking the peculiar power sources employed by the Mi-Go, this weapon instead draws power from the life force of the wielder (
target: 当缺乏 Mi-Go 所使用的特殊能量源的生物使用时，这种武器会从使用者的生命力中汲取能量（

source: Whenever a hostile spell is blocked due to spell resistance, it is also reflected. The number of turns to regain spell resistance is halved.
target: 每当敌对法术因法术抗力而被阻挡时，它也会被反射。恢复法术抗力的回合数减半。

source: Wielded by rulers in ancient times, this powerful artifact holds power over those that were once bound to it. Any mummy beholding the owner will eventually be converted (10% chance per turn while the weapon is carried).
target: 这件强大的神器由古代统治者所使用，对那些曾经受其束缚的人拥有力量。任何看到主人的木乃伊最终都会被转化（携带武器时每回合 10% c 机会）。
自史前时代起就被使用。

source: - The player is asked for confirmation when picking traits on gaining new character levels (but not when creating a new character)
target: - 获得新角色等级并选择特质时，游戏会要求玩家确认（创建新角色时除外）

source: - The player symbol is colored yellow when carrying a lit Electric Lantern
target: - 携带点亮的电灯笼时，玩家符号呈黄色

source: - The popup boxes have new border graphics (thanks to Christopher Barrett, aka Oryx), and the box and text layout is much nicer looking
target: - 弹出框有新的边框图形（感谢 Christopher Barrett，又名 Oryx），并且框和文本布局看起来更漂亮

source: - The postmortem info shows gained abilities
target: - 尸检信息显示获得的能力

source: - The postmortem information no longer lists number of kills for each type of monster, instead it only lists unique monsters killed, and the total number of monsters
target: - 尸检信息不再列出每种怪物的击杀数量，而是只列出击杀的唯一怪物以及怪物总数

source: - The potion "See Invisible" is now a spell instead
target: - 药水“隐形”现在是一个咒语

source: - The Potion of Invisibility effect ends when attacking or casting spells, and has much shorter duration
target: - 隐形药水效果在攻击或施法时结束，并且持续时间短得多

source: - The pre-set player name is empty instead of "Player"
target: - 预设的玩家名称为空而不是“玩家”

source: - The Purge spell description now also includes mirrors in the list of objects it can destroy (it could already destroy them but it was not described).
target: - 净化法术描述现在还包括它可以摧毁的物体列表中的镜子（它已经可以摧毁它们，但没有描述）。

source: - The rats summoned by the Pestilence spell appear scattered throughout an area (instead of grouped around the caster), and the spell only last for a limited time.
target: - 瘟疫法术召唤的老鼠分散在整个区域（而不是聚集在施法者周围），并且该法术仅持续有限的时间。

source: - The Rejuvenator Device causes heavy shock when used
target: - 使用回春装置会造成严重震慑

source: - The released version of the game is now built on Debian Bullseye with gcc 10.2.1 - glibc 2.31 or newer is required to play the game on Linux.
target: - 游戏发行版现在基于 Debian Bullseye 和 gcc 10.2.1 构建；在 Linux 上运行游戏需要 glibc 2.31 或更新版本。

source: - The required dungeon level for monster group sizes in monsters.xml can now also be specified relative to the minimum dungeon level of the monster (with format "+N" levels). For example if a monster has min_dungeon_level "4", then a group_size entry with required_dungeon_level="+2" will cause the monster to start spawning with that group size on dungeon level 6.
target: - 现在可以按怪物最低地城层数的相对值指定 monsters.xml 中怪物群体规模所需的地城层数（格式为“+N 层”）。例如，若怪物的 min_dungeon_level 为 "4"，则 required_dungeon_level="+2" 的 group_size 条目会让该怪物从地城第 6 层起以该群体规模生成。

source: - The Rogue background receives -25% passive shock (instead of -50%)
target: - 盗贼背景受到的被动震慑降低为 -25%（此前为 -50%）

source: - The ruins in the late game caves can contain chests, tombs, or altars.
target: - 游戏后期洞穴中的废墟可能包含箱子、坟墓或祭坛。

source: - The screen fades to red when the player dies.
target: - 当玩家死亡时，屏幕会变成红色。

source: - The screen is now redrawn when toggling fullscreen (previously the screen would be black until you entered a command)
target: - 现在，切换全屏时会重新绘制屏幕（之前屏幕会呈黑色，直到您输入命令）

source: - The searching skill (now called "Observant") no longer increases your chance of finding a secret door, instead if gives a chance to mark walls (you find a clue about a secret passage)
target: - 搜索技能（现在称为“观察者”）不再增加你找到秘密门的机会，而是有机会标记墙壁（你找到有关秘密通道的线索）

source: - The Shockwave Device is a Rod instead
target: - 震波装置现在改为魔棒

source: - The skill system uses ranks again (instead of percentages)
target: - 技能系统再次使用排名（而不是百分比）

source: - The spell "Animate Weapons" has been changed to "Spectral Weapons" - instead of animating weapons on the floor, it summons a living copy of melee weapon in your inventory (which will simply disappear after a while, without dropping any weapons on the floor)
target: - 咒语“动画武器”已更改为“光谱武器” - 它不再是在地板上动画武器，而是在你的库存中召唤近战武器的活体副本（它会在一段时间后消失，而不会在地板上掉落任何武器）

source: - The spell "Enfeeble" now only causes Weakening (instead of a bunch of different things)
target: - “削弱”法术现在只会施加虚弱效果，不再产生多种不同效果。

source: - The spell "Healing" is now also available for the player
target: - 咒语“治疗”现在也可供玩家使用

source: - The spell "Summon Creature" picks more sensible monsters when cast by the player (e.g. a Wolf will not appear when cast at Master level)
target: - 玩家施放咒语“召唤生物”时会选择更明智的怪物（例如，在大师级别施放时不会出现狼）

source: - The spell that you gain after reaching a certain level of Mythos knowledge ("Thaumaturgic Alteration"), now chooses effect automatically (instead of player selecting the effect from a menu), this can include a random manuscript-spell, or a special effect if the circumstances allow it.
target: - 达到一定神话知识水平后获得的法术（“奇术改变”）现在会自动选择效果（而不是玩家从菜单中选择效果），这可以包括随机的手稿法术，或者如果情况允许的话可以包括特殊效果。

source: - The spells "Summon Creature" and "Summon Mummy Servant" costs one less spirit to cast
target: - 法术“召唤生物”和“召唤木乃伊仆人”的施展精神消耗减少1个
